subject: Feature Request - Segments for Individual Samples and Plotting

messages.author: de836d15494c1655
messages.subject: Feature Request - Segments for Individual Samples and Plotting
parts:
Hi,
I have been checking out the latest Sequenza code on BitBucket, and have been utilizing the new $depths element that provides depths to mean / median ratios for the individual samples used (both raw and normalized). They have been very useful! 

I was wondering if you might implement a couple additional features: 1) perform segmentation on at least the normalized depths (both samples); and 2) include that in the RData extract; optional: 3) plot the segments in red in the new chromosome depths PDF.

Thanks,
Erich

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: Feature Request - Segments for Individual Samples and Plotting
parts:
Hi Erich,

thanks for the feedback! Yes, I think that splitting the depths is quite useful, also for QC purpose.
I can try to implement the segmentation on individual samples, although that should increase considerably the running time.
The segmentation should be performed with a depth only approach (rather then an allele specific approach), this is by far slower then the default segmentation algorithm used in the extract function.

But I agree, that would be very useful (eg to exclude regions with germline CNV - or just messy regions in the normal -).
If I manage to include the segmentation (point 1), there is no reason not to include point 2 and 3.
Maybe I can add a flag in the sequenza.extract interface that triggers the segmentation of the samples when enabled. So the user expects a slower running with the option, rather then be slow by default…

Francesco
